notes: This is a build/packaging plus fix-a-broken-build task with a specific NumPy-2.0 C-API compatibility twist. TMax-15K is by far the strongest pool: it has many 'vendored package with a broken setup.py that must compile a Cython/C extension' tasks, several of which literally use `python setup.py build_ext --inplace`, and task_000112 additionally drives the compiled module with a numpy array. Recursive-Task-Synthesis contributes one exact match (build+install a custom C extension in a venv) plus a long tail of generic build-from-source chores. SWE-Rebench is the only pool carrying the NumPy-2/Cython compatibility angle explicitly: setuptools-4676 for the native-extension build machinery, and arch-741/h5py-2433 for numpy-2-vs-compiled-extension breakage; these lose on task_form (bug fix) but are the best domain matches for the compatibility crux. SWE-Smith has no numpy/cython build task, so I mapped it to the conan C/C++ toolchain-and-compiler-flag bugs, which at least exercise how native compiles are configured. TerminalWorld is C/C++ from-source builds with the tinyget Python-wheel tasks as the closest ecosystem match. The retrieval shortlist for TMax was reasonable here (many genuine build-failure tasks) but I still had to run build_ext/cython searches to surface the specifically Cython-extension ones over generic 'fix the vendored package' matches.
